files.name: generateSchema.js
files.description:
library used to generate API schema
It reads all the files in the selected directory and generates a schema of the API for each directory.

params.name: key
params.description: the key to be used in the handler, ex: the key of "+" is "sum"

params.name: tag
params.description: (optional) The tag name of the element, defaults to "div"

params.name: classList
params.description: (optional) The class list of the element

params.name: callback
params.description: (optional) Executed when the element is created, ex: (element) => element.innerHTML = "Hello world"; or function() { this.innerHTML = "Hello world"; }
